A feast for an estimated four lakh guests, around 50 lakh gulab jamuns reportedly being prepared, and a Mahindra Thar for the winner of a horse race. Mokama MLA Anant Singh’s daughter Shivangi is set to marry Rishikesh Kumar on November 25 in Ladma, Bihar. The wedding is already drawing attention, and days later, Singh is due to surrender after the Supreme Court cancelled his bail in the Dularchand Yadav murder case.
